title: Engineering Prototypes
description: Precision-engineered prototypes for automotive and industrial applications.
fullDescription: An example of high-precision prototypes such as bracket assemblies, housing covers and functional test parts. Components are printed with tight tolerances using FDM, then post-processed for surface finish and dimensional accuracy — suitable for fit-and-function testing before committing to tooling.

title: Custom Miniatures
description: Detailed miniature figurines and customized decorative models.
fullDescription: Highly detailed miniature figurines and decorative models. Printed for fine surface detail and hand-finished where required, ready for display or painting. Designs can be based on reference artwork or custom requirements.

title: Product Development
description: Product design, CAD modeling and engineering from concept to final model.
fullDescription: End-to-end product development: CAD modeling from initial sketches, iterative prototypes for ergonomic testing, and design refinement across multiple revision cycles — producing a prototype suitable for presentations and photography.

title: 3D Printed Models
description: Architectural and conceptual models for visualization and testing.
fullDescription: Conceptual and architectural scale models for presentation and visualization. Printed in multiple parts and assembled with precision, then finished and detailed to match the design intent.

title: Industrial Components
description: Batch production of functional parts and custom industrial components.
fullDescription: Batch production of functional components such as jigs, fixtures and end-use parts. A consistent quality-control process keeps dimensions repeatable across the batch, with parts delivered to schedule.

title: Custom Keychains
description: Personalized keychains for corporate events and individual orders.
fullDescription: Custom branded keychains with raised-relief logos and flexible loops. The full workflow — from logo vectorization to print and finishing — is handled in-house, with items individually finished and ready for distribution.

title: Mechanical Parts
description: Custom mechanical components and assemblies for various applications.
fullDescription: Custom mechanical components including gears, brackets and housing assemblies. Printed in durable materials and post-processed (drilling, tapping, surface treatment) for final assembly integration.

title: Architectural Models
description: Scale models for architectural presentations and real estate projects.
fullDescription: Detailed scale architectural models for presentations and real estate visualization — building blocks with surrounding landscape, roads and greenery, printed in parts and finished for display.

title: Functional Prototypes
description: Working prototypes for product validation and iterative development.
fullDescription: Working prototypes and educational models for validation and demonstration. Enclosures, mechanisms and assembled units can be used for user testing, with feedback informing the final design.
